no-restricted-globals.name: window
no-restricted-globals.message: sim/ and gen/ run headless and must stay deterministic, so there is no DOM. Read it in render/ or ui/ and pass the value in, or keep the state in the sim.

no-restricted-globals.name: requestAnimationFrame
no-restricted-globals.message: sim/ is stepped by the caller at a fixed 60 Hz, so it cannot schedule itself. Do the work inside a step.

no-restricted-globals.name: setTimeout
no-restricted-globals.message: sim/ is stepped by the caller at a fixed 60 Hz, so timers break determinism. Count frames in sim state instead.

patterns.message: src/ is framework-free so the game stays portable. Put Next.js code in app/ and have it call plain functions exported from src/.

sim/, gen/ and game/ run headless and deterministically, so they cannot depend on presentation, input or audio. Push a GameEvent or expose state for render/ and audio/ to read; inputs arrive as InputFrame.
